data.define: Used for something that makes you laugh a lot.

misuse.text: Don't say 'hilarious' about someone's real accident.

publish.title: What does "hilarious" mean?
publish.value: Hilarious = Extremely funny. Example: "That joke was hilarious!" (everyday English).
